scrapeType.title: Scrape type
scrapeType.description: company = profile; filings = filing list; facts = XBRL financial facts; form4 = insider transactions; search = EDGAR full-text search.

companies.title: Companies
companies.description: Tickers, CIK numbers or EDGAR URLs, e.g. ["AAPL", "0000320193", "TSLA"].

formTypes.title: Form types (filings mode)
formTypes.description: Filter filings by form type, e.g. ["10-K", "10-Q", "8-K"]. Empty = all.

concepts.title: XBRL concepts (facts mode)
concepts.description: Substring filters for XBRL concepts, e.g. ["Revenue", "NetIncomeLoss"]. Empty = all concepts (large).

maxFilingsPerCompany.title: Max filings per company
maxFilingsPerCompany.description: Cap on filings collected per company.

maxFactsPerCompany.title: Max facts per company
maxFactsPerCompany.description: Cap on XBRL facts collected per company.

maxForm4PerCompany.title: Max Form 4 filings per company
maxForm4PerCompany.description: Recent Form 4 filings to parse per company.

maxTransactionsPerFiling.title: Max transactions per Form 4
maxTransactionsPerFiling.description: Cap on insider transactions extracted per Form 4 filing.

searchQuery.title: Search query (search mode)
searchQuery.description: Full-text search query, e.g. "artificial intelligence" or a company/product term.

searchForms.title: Search form types (search mode)
searchForms.description: Filter search by form type, e.g. ["10-K", "8-K"].

maxItems.title: Max rows total
maxItems.description: Overall cap on rows pushed to the dataset.
